friction.note: The primitive needs a new PromptRole (shuffleInto, a resolution-time hand choice after draws) and a new event kind (shuffledIntoDeck: a hand-to-deck move has no announcing event). Their registration files (battle-prompt-messages.ts, presentation-items.ts, policy/prompts.ts, engine-battle-view-model.test.ts) were outside the dispatched Areas, so the subagent stopped and the session widened them.

The first weighted fuzz failed 175 games: EventRedaction judged identification only before and after a step, so a card Fragments of Vision drew and then shuffled back into the deck in the same step looked like a leak in cardDrawn and shuffledIntoDeck for its own drawer. The invariant now also counts a card that entered the viewer's own hand during the step (src/engine/testing/redaction.ts).

The first card sweep's MCP request timed out at 'Skysign inspired as enemy' (Session not found afterwards) and left the browser owner record for reconciliation; the provider session was gone and the server stopped, so the record was cleared and the full sweep re-run cleanly (30 pass, 30 skip).
